findings.title: Async forEach is not awaited when deleting calendar/video events
findings.body: bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async ...) starts asynchronous getCalendar/deleteEvent/deleteMeeting work, but the surrounding Reschedule function does not await those promises. The try/catch around forEach cannot catch async rejections, so the function sends the reschedule email and returns before external events are reliably deleted. Failed deletions can leave stale calendar/video events and cause unhandled promise rejections. Use Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(...)) instead.

findings.title: Async forEach is not awaited when deleting calendar/video events
findings.body: bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async ...) starts asynchronous getCalendar/deleteEvent/deleteMeeting work, but the surrounding Reschedule function does not await those promises. The try/catch around forEach cannot catch async rejections, so the function sends the reschedule email and returns before external events are reliably deleted. Failed deletions can leave stale calendar/video events and cause unhandled promise rejections. Use Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(...)) instead.

findings.title: requestReschedule does not await calendar/video deletion promises
findings.body: In requestReschedule, bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async ...) fires asynchronous calendar/video deletion operations without awaiting them. The mutation then sends the reschedule email and webhooks and returns while deletions may still be pending. Errors from those deletions are not handled and can become unhandled promise rejections. Use Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(...)) and await it before continuing.

findings.title: Recurring cancellation calendar deletions are not awaited or reliably collected
findings.body: For recurring cancellations, the code calls credentials.filter(...).forEach(async ...), awaits getCalendar/deleteEvent inside the callback, and only then pushes the delete promise into apiDeletes. Because forEach does not await async callbacks, the handler can reach Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes)) before those promises are pushed, so calendar deletions may not be awaited or included at all. This can leave cancelled recurring events in external calendars and cause unhandled rejections. Use a for...of loop or Promise.all over mapped credentials and await the resulting promises.

findings.title: Awaiting the apiDeletes array does not wait for integration deletions
findings.body: In the paid cancellation branch, `await apiDeletes;` awaits the array object rather than the promises inside it. As a result, deleteMeeting/calendar delete operations may still be pending when the handler returns, and their rejections are not observed. Use `await Promise.all(apiDeletes)` to wait for all integration deletion promises.

findings.title: Dynamic import failures bypass createMeeting's fallback handling
findings.body: createMeeting awaits getVideoAdapters before the try/catch that handles broken video integrations and falls back to Cal Video. Since getVideoAdapters now performs dynamic imports from appStore, a rejected import throws before that try/catch, so the broken-integration email and Cal Video fallback do not run and booking creation can fail hard. Move the getVideoAdapters call into the try block or catch import failures and fall back.

findings.title: getCalendar propagates dynamic import rejections instead of degrading gracefully
findings.body: The awaited appStore lookup can reject if an app chunk fails to load. getCalendar does not catch this rejection, so callers such as CalendarManager.createEvent/updateEvent and booking cancellation flows can throw instead of treating the calendar as unavailable. For resilience, catch import errors, log them, and return null (or otherwise normalize the failure) where callers already handle missing calendars.

findings.title: Video adapters are loaded sequentially
findings.body: getVideoAdapters loops over credentials and awaits each appStore dynamic import one at a time. When multiple video credentials are present, this serializes module loading and delays availability checks, meeting creation, updates, and deletions. Use Promise.all to import the needed app modules concurrently.
